proposal.target: quote_fx (FX tool, free-allowance handling for tier2)
proposal.change: Apply the remaining 200 EUR free allowance so the spread is charged only on the portion of the amount exceeding it, instead of on the full 3000 EUR.
proposal.diff_preview:
--- a/fx/quote.py
+++ b/fx/quote.py
@@ quote_fx()
- taxable = amount
+ remaining_allowance = max(0.0, allowance_total_eur - allowance_used_before_eur)
+ taxable = max(0.0, amount - remaining_allowance)
  spread_amount = taxable * mid_rate * spread_pct / 100
  allowance_applied = remaining_allowance > 0
proposal.risk: Expected value 3231.52 implies spread on 2800 EUR (27.39 on... ) but the engine's own expectation is ambiguous: the trace says allowance was ignored (D21), yet 'allowance_applied': false and the reported answer's allowance wording conflicts with the 800 EUR used figure; confirm the intended allowance semantics before changing the calculation, since altering fee math affects all tier2 quotes and any case expectation may itself be wrong (eval case FX-002 lives under sets/, which is protected).
